name: Enterprise DevOps Platform
icp_description: We sell a CI/CD and infrastructure observability platform to engineering organizations with more than 50 engineers. Buyers are VP Engineering, Head of Platform, or DevOps leads who own build pipelines and production reliability. We do not target agencies or single-developer teams.

criteria.name: Decision-maker access
criteria.description: The lead content identifies a contact with authority over engineering tooling, such as VP Engineering, Head of Platform, or a senior DevOps lead.

criteria.name: Technical pain point
criteria.description: The lead states a concrete problem with build speed, deployment reliability, or infrastructure visibility.

criteria.name: Team size sufficient
criteria.description: The lead states or clearly implies an engineering team of 50 or more people.

criteria.name: Existing tooling mentioned
criteria.description: The lead references current CI/CD, cloud, or observability tooling being used or replaced.

industry_levels: Irrelevant sector with no software engineering function
Adjacent sector with a small or outsourced engineering team
Core target: software, SaaS, or technology-driven engineering organization
maturity_levels: No funding or team information stated
Early-stage startup, seed to Series A
Growth-stage company, Series B or later
intent_levels: No stated need or evaluation activity
Passive interest, such as a newsletter signup or content download
Actively comparing vendors or requesting a demo
Stated budget and timeline to purchase

routing.name: immediate_sdr_outreach
routing.description: Strong ICP fit, decision-maker access, and active buying intent. Route to an SDR for immediate outreach.

routing.name: nurture_sequence
routing.description: Reasonable ICP fit but low urgency or no confirmed decision-maker. Add to a nurture email sequence.

routing.name: disqualify
routing.description: Poor ICP fit, wrong industry, or no evidence of a real business need. Disqualify the lead.

name: Mid-Market Fintech Compliance
icp_description: We sell automated transaction-monitoring and compliance software to banks, payment processors, and lending platforms with regulatory reporting obligations. Buyers are Heads of Compliance, Risk Officers, or General Counsel. We do not target unregulated retail or consumer apps.

criteria.name: Regulatory obligation
criteria.description: The lead content states a regulatory reporting, KYC, or AML obligation relevant to financial services.

criteria.name: Compliance buyer identified
criteria.description: The lead identifies a contact responsible for compliance, risk, or legal functions.

criteria.name: Manual process pain point
criteria.description: The lead describes a current manual, slow, or error-prone compliance process.

industry_levels: Non-financial business with no regulatory reporting need
Adjacent financial service with limited regulatory scope
Core target: bank, payment processor, or lending platform with direct regulatory obligations
maturity_levels: Established regulated institution with a dedicated compliance function
intent_levels: General awareness of upcoming regulatory change
Actively seeking a compliance vendor or facing an audit deadline

routing.name: immediate_sdr_outreach
routing.description: Confirmed regulatory obligation, right buyer, and near-term deadline. Route to an SDR for immediate outreach.

routing.name: nurture_sequence
routing.description: Fits the regulated profile but no urgent deadline stated. Add to a nurture sequence with compliance-deadline content.

routing.name: disqualify
routing.description: No regulatory obligation or the business is out of scope for financial compliance software. Disqualify the lead.
